text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this way, please. The tea is ready to be served.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a change of pace, I've been invited to the Mejiro household for tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All of us getting together for tea like this reminds me of when we were little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It really does. Oh! Do you remember the height tree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That tree in the back garden? Oh yes, that's where Ardan was gracious enough to mark our heights on the trunk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You really shot up fast when you were little, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Dober barely grew at all, and kept standing on her tiptoes to make herself look taller… Didn't you stumble over at one point?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you trying to embarrass me?! Still, I do remember Ardan being the one who comforted me when that happened.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Owwwieee!

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm just going to give you some first aid, okay? …See? It doesn't hurt. Once I'm finished, shall we go and have some sweet tea?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You always used to prepare a cup of tea for me when I cried, Ardan. Your tea was subtly sweet, and its taste really put me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for saying that. …But thinking back on it now, perhaps I should have added a little more sugar, since you were a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My palate was so accustomed to subtle flavors at the time, it never occurred to me… What do you think of your tea, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Really, though. Just because my trainer's here doesn't mean you have to talk exclusively about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But we hardly ever get the chance to talk about you! Oh! Say, Ardan, do you remember that time I got lost in the manor…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Things are going well, with everyone having a great time reminiscing, until I excuse myself to use the restroom…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I try to head back the way I came, I somehow wind up in the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer? Where have you gone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As relief washes over me, I happen to remember the story from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Do you remember that time I got lost in the manor and you came to find me? It was freezing, but you searched high and low for me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And then the next day, you were sick in bed. I felt terrible! I think I'm pretty sure I cried my eyes out…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, if memory serves, you spent so much time at Ardan's bedside that the maid scolded you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Maaan… Yeah, knowing how I was back then, I wouldn't have let her out of my sight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Oh! There you are, Trainer. What a relief!
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you come find me.
Sorry for making you come find me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll have you know that I've been the Mejiro family's undisputed hide-and-seek champion for a very long time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: After all, much of my youth was spent convalescing within the manor… The halls are vast and intricate, but before I knew it, I had the layout committed to memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As such… no matter how many times you lose your way in here, I can say with confidence that I'll find you.
choice_data_list: Thanks. I don't see myself getting lost over and over, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, that's unfortunate. I was planning to serve you a cup of extra-sweet tea in the event I found you lost and crying, all by yourself. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Oh? Things certainly look lively outside.
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone stepped out into the garden.
Looks like everyone stepped out into the garden.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It looks as if they're searching for the height tree. Seeing them doing that makes me feel as if I've stepped back in time to when we were all children.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I doubt that any of them will get lost again… but I'm not sure whether that makes me happy or… sad…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I doubt that any of them will get lost again… but I'm not sure whether that makes me happy or… sad…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Hehe… ♪ Well, fortunately for me, there's still a sweet little someone getting lost like a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Which reminds me… Trainer, I believe you nodded off in your office the other day, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The sight of you snoozing away… was rather adorable, I must say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heeey! You guys! We found the tree!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …! Hehe… Thank you for letting us know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You know, they've always had a habit of overexerting themselves. Sometimes for pride, sometimes to realize their dreams… And I know how they feel painfully well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's why I wish to help them. It's only by a little, but I am the oldest, so I'd like to be their role model…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heeey! You guys! We found the tree!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's Ryan for you, yelling away at the top of her lungs… Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's be on our way, Trainer. I expect they're waiting for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day ends up being a very special one, as I get to glimpse a different side of Mejiro Ardan!
